text: Nature Robots develops modular autonomy software and hardware for AI-powered, GNSS-independent autonomous farming in complex environments. Nature Robots has raised $4.6M in total funding. The most recent round was Seed. The last funding was announced in March 2026. Nature Robots's investors include Marc Matthaeus, Bayern Kapital, Climentum Capital, EIC Accelerator, Planetary Impact Ventures. Nature Robots is headquartered in Osnabrück, Germany.
